title: The Annals of Albany, volume VI: Steam Navigation on the Hudson
version: Albany, J. Munsell, 1855, vol. VI. University of Toronto library copy.
lineage: Scan of the printed 1855 volume. Wilson’s retrospective account reproduces a 5 September 1807 passenger statement that the account says was published in the Albany Register on 8 September 1807. The newspaper issue was not inspected.

passages.locator: Vol. VI, pp. 23 and 25, Wilson’s account and passenger statement dated 5 September 1807
passages.note: Passenger John Q. Wilson places the opening packet on Friday, 4 September. His account reprints the signed passenger statement, dated at Albany on 5 September, which records a Friday departure from New York and arrival at Albany.
